entries.topic: The 27 November 2024 cessation of hostilities: text, side letter, deadlines, five positions, stated positions

claims.text: The US- and French-announced 'Announcement of a Cessation of Hostilities and Related Commitments' took effect at 04:00 on 27 November 2024; 13 points; Lebanon to prevent Hezbollah and others attacking Israel; Israel to carry out no offensive operations against Lebanese targets; both keep 'inherent right of self-defense'; only official Lebanese forces armed south of the Litani; reformulated Mechanism hosted by UNIFIL, chaired by US, including France; phased Israeli withdrawal coordinated over a period that 'should not exceed 60 days'; aim of 10,000 LAF troops in the south

Israel's Channel 12 reported a US side letter affirming Israel's right to act against threats from Lebanon and to fly reconnaissance; ToI had not seen it; in late October Israel had sought US commitment for 'freedom of action to respond to any violation'

Netanyahu, 26 Nov 2024: 'With the United States' full understanding, we maintain full freedom of military action'; three reasons: focus on Iran, give forces a breather and replenish stocks, separate the fronts and isolate Hamas

Biden, 26 Nov 2024: 'designed to be a permanent cessation of hostilities'; Israel 'retains the right to self-defense'; over 60 days LAF deploys; Hezbollah infrastructure 'will not be allowed to be rebuilt'
Qassem, 29 Nov 2024, claimed 'divine victory' greater than 2006 and said coordination with the army 'will be at a high level'

26 Jan 2025: at least 22 killed, 124 injured (Lebanese health ministry) as residents tried to return; Israeli army said it fired warning shots to 'remove threats'; White House said arrangement extended to 18 Feb 2025

Israel said it would stay at five posts after 18 Feb 2025 (Jabal Blat, Labbouneh, Al Azziyeh, Al Awidah, El Hamames); Shoshani: 'We need to remain at those points at the moment to defend Israeli citizens'; Aoun insisted on withdrawal; Qassem: 'Israel must fully withdraw on February 18, it has no excuse'

entries.topic: Violations and deaths during the 2024-2026 ceasefire

claims.text: UNIFIL, 27 Nov 2024-27 Nov 2025: almost 7,800 air violations, over 2,500 IDF activities north of the Blue Line, over 100 air attacks, over 1,000 trajectories almost all from the Israeli side; over 360 unauthorized weapons caches referred to the LAF; IDF at five locations plus two buffer zones
UNIFIL said it recorded more than 10,000 Israeli air and ground violations in the twelve months; L'Orient-Le Jour's own count: over 12,000 violations and 343 deaths, 27 Nov 2024-14 Nov 2025

OHCHR: at least 127 civilians killed in Lebanon by Israeli forces from 27 Nov 2024 to 24 Nov 2025; Ein el-Hilweh strike killed at least 13 civilians including 11 children; about 64,000 still displaced

Lebanese health ministry: at least 331 killed and 945 injured by Israeli fire since the ceasefire (as of 24 Nov 2025); 23 Nov 2025 Beirut strike killed Haytham Ali Tabatabai, 5 killed, 28 injured; Netanyahu said Tabatabai led Hezbollah's 'buildup and armament'
2 Dec 2024: Hezbollah fired two projectiles at Shebaa Farms/Mount Dov, calling it a 'defensive and warning response' to Israeli violations; no injuries

22 Mar 2025: six rockets fired from Lebanon at Metula; Hezbollah denied responsibility and reiterated commitment to ceasefire; Katz: 'the fate of Metula is the same as Beirut'; Israeli strikes killed at least six in Lebanon that day (health ministry)
IDF, 27 Nov 2025: eliminated 'more than 370 terrorists' from Hezbollah, Hamas and other groups in the year; about 1,200 'targeted activities' by 91st Division
Lebanon's foreign ministry complaint to UNSC (Jan 2026): 2,036 Israeli violations in Oct-Dec 2025 (542, 691, 803)
Mechanism: 13th meeting Nov 2025; Lebanese army complained Israel did not notify committee in advance of suspected weapons sites as process requires
3 Dec 2025: civilian representatives (Lebanon's Simon Karam) joined the Mechanism meeting in Naqoura with US envoy Ortagus, first direct civilian talks in over 40 years

Security Council Report: most recent reported rocket launches toward Israel were in March 2025; CENTCOM said 16 Oct 2025 the LAF had removed about 10,000 rockets and 400 missiles; UNSC resolution 2790 (28 Aug 2025) extended UNIFIL a final time to 31 Dec 2026 with withdrawal within a year; army plan in five geographic phases

entries.topic: Aoun, Salam and the state monopoly on arms; the US paper; the army plan; reconstruction

claims.text: Aoun elected 9 Jan 2025 with 99 of 128 votes; pledged to 'confirm the state's right to monopolise the carrying of weapons'
Salam, president of the ICJ, designated PM 13 Jan 2025 with backing of more than half of MPs; Hezbollah did not back him

5 Aug 2025: cabinet tasked army with plan to restrict weapons to the state before end of 2025, plan due end of August; Qassem: 'Any timetable presented for implementation under... Israeli aggression cannot be agreed to'

7 Aug 2025: cabinet adopted objectives of US envoy Tom Barrack's paper: gradual end of armed presence of all non-state actors including Hezbollah, Israeli withdrawal, halt to Israeli strikes, prisoner release, border demarcation; Shiite ministers walked out; Hezbollah said it would 'treat this decision as if it does not exist'
5 Sep 2025: cabinet 'welcomed' army commander Rodolphe Haykal's plan without timetable; five Shiite ministers walked out; army cited limited capabilities

8 Jan 2026: Lebanese army said its plan had reached an advanced stage with operational control south of the Litani except five Israeli positions; Netanyahu's office called it an 'encouraging start' but 'far from sufficient' and said 'Hezbollah must be fully disarmed'
World Bank RDNA: $11bn reconstruction and recovery needs; $14bn cost ($6.8bn damage, $7.2bn losses), period 8 Oct 2023-20 Dec 2024; GDP fell 7.1% in 2024
Al Jazeera (May 2025): major donors like the US pushing for Hezbollah disarmament as precondition for reconstruction aid

entries.topic: The 2026 Lebanon war inside the US-Israel war on Iran

claims.text: US and Israel launched joint strikes on Iran on 28 Feb 2026; Trump announced Khamenei 'is dead'; Iranian state TV confirmed early next day

Khamenei killed in initial strikes of 28 Feb 2026 (Operation Epic Fury / Roaring Lion); two-week Iran ceasefire from 8 April; Islamabad Memorandum signed 17 June; ceasefire collapsed 8 July per this page

2 Mar 2026: Hezbollah launched missiles and drones at Israel, first since the strikes on Iran, citing Khamenei's killing and Israeli violations; IDF said it 'will not enable the organization to constitute a threat'

2 Mar 2026: Lebanese cabinet banned all Hezbollah 'military and security actions' and told army to implement disarmament north of the Litani; Salam: 'absolute rejection... of any military or security action' outside state institutions
By 24 Mar 2026 Israeli strikes had killed at least 1,039 people and displaced more than a million (AFP)

Chronology: ground operation from 16 Mar; Katz said IDF would control south up to the Litani; 8 Apr strikes killed at least 357; 16/17 Apr ten-day truce announced by Trump, later extended; 18 Apr 'yellow line' over 55 villages; talks in Washington mid-May; IDF crossed Litani and took Beaufort 31 May; 19 June truce; 26 June Rubio framework rejected by Hezbollah; mid-July handover of pilot zones; IDF claimed 150+ fighters killed by 16 April; health ministry over 3,000 dead by 18 May
Lebanese health ministry provisional toll 2 Mar-16 Apr 2026: 2,294 killed, 7,544 injured, including 100 health and rescue workers killed
Lebanon disaster risk management unit, 21 Apr 2026: 2,454 killed, 7,658 wounded
Health ministry, 2 May 2026: 2,659 killed, 8,183 injured since 2 March; 41 killed in previous 24 hours; over one million displaced

Lebanon's government said Israel carried out 3,491 air strikes, 407 controlled demolitions and six razing operations 17 Apr-7 Jun 2026; over 1 million displaced; Hezbollah continued firing; Trump said ceasefires involve 'shooting in a more moderate manner'
